facts.text: The Pack Promise program at CSU Pueblo provides awards covering remaining in-state tuition for undergraduate Colorado residents with a total family income of $70,000 or less.

sources.title: Pack Promise | Scholarships | CSU Pueblo
sources.quote: The Pack Promise program at CSU Pueblo provides awards covering the remaining in-state tuition after all state, federal, and institutional grants and scholarships have been applied.

sources.title: Pack Promise | Scholarships | CSU Pueblo
sources.quote: Have a total family income of $70,000 or less based on FAFSA data. Be an in-state, undergraduate, degree-seeking student.

facts.text: The Colorado Promise program offers a tax credit that helps cover tuition and fees for qualifying undergraduate Colorado residents with family income of $90,000 or less attending within two years of graduating from high school.

sources.title: Colorado Promise | Scholarships | CSU Pueblo
sources.quote: The Colorado Promise is a program established by the State of Colorado that offers a tax credit to eligible students whose family income is $90,000 or less.

sources.title: Colorado Promise | Scholarships | CSU Pueblo
sources.quote: The program helps cover tuition and fees for qualifying undergraduate students who attend a Colorado public institution within two years of graduating from high school.
